{{Quote|Hey, Lore, you got anything going on?''"<br />"''Got a routine run to Siskeen for a shipment of rock wart eggs. Could do it in my sleep.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Avik Lore]]|<ref name="Rebel Force: Renegade">''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]''</ref>}}
'''Siskeen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. 

==History==
{{Quote|The marshaling of our other forces on the Outer Rim&mdash;at Xagobah, Siskeen, Clak'dor VII, and Sluis Van&mdash;is also near completion. The war will soon be decided.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Republic 73">[[Republic 73|''Republic'' 73]]</ref>}}
'''Siskeen''' was a strategically held world within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. 

At the start of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was building up forces on the world. The [[Siskeen theater]], one of the main theaters of this campaign, was named after this planet due to its importance to the Separatist cause.
